# Method SetDimensionStyle

#### SetDimensionStyle(ElementId, ElementId)

Sets style of a dimension

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 20, 255, 0)]
void SetDimensionStyle(ElementId inDimensionElementId, ElementId inStyleElementId)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  ElementId |  inDimensionElementId |  The dimension  |  
 
|  ElementId |  inStyleElementId |  The style to use  |  

##### Remarks

StartModification(string, bool) and EnsureIsDirty(ref DocumentId) must be called before calling this method.
 
This method is available since v7.19.
